notes.subject: לשבועה
notes.rationale: 'Oath' o 'kros': KJV/JPS lukim 'curse', YLT lukim 'oath' — nem bilong ol i kamap wanpela tok bilong swearim (olsem 'Yahwe bai mekim olsem long yu') o long tok bilong kros.

notes.subject: yu
notes.rationale: והמיתך i gat pikinini tok 'yu' long Hibru; mi bracketim ⟨yu⟩ long ples bilong verb.

notes.subject: yupela
notes.rationale: Yahwe i toktok olgeta long ol man i lus — tupela lain: ol wokman bilong em na ol i no harim tok.

translation: Na yupela bai lusim nem bilong yupela long swearim long ol man bilong mi ol i makim; Adonai Yahwe bai kilim ⟨yu⟩, na long ol wokman bilong em i bai kolim narapela nem.

tokens.gloss: long ol man bilong mi ol i makim
na long ol wokman bilong em
